items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: there's a brother out here by the name of Stanley Stahl

ctx.x: Somebody said it might have a Z in. That sounds something like the way you said it.

No, no, it's not no Z. No Z. No, not Stahls. It's Stahls. It's T-A-W-L-S. I think that's what it's spelled. I never find it. I looked at it. Yeah, there's a brother out here by the name of Stanley Stahl.
